findings.text: Unset removes entries from ExpectedCalls while ranging over the same slice with the original index i. After one removal the slice is shorter and later elements shift left, so the next element is skipped and a stale copy of the last element is still visited. If two consecutive expectations match the same method and arguments, only one is removed. If a later match is reached after a removal, ExpectedCalls[i+1:] can use an index beyond the new length and panic, or delete the wrong call.
